anatomicalAxesOrientation._instruction: Add the axes orientation denoted in standard anatomical terms of direction (stated as XYZ) for the anatomical space of this custom coordinate framework.

axesOrigin._instruction: Enter the coordinate point in the native anatomical space of the template as [x, y] or [x, y, z] for two- or three-dimensional spaces, respectively, that has been defined as the origin of the anatomical space of this custom coordinate framework (i.e., as the central point where all axes intersect).

defaultImage._instruction: Add all image files used as visual representation of this custom coordinate framework.

name._instruction: Enter a descriptive name for this custom coordinate framework.

nativeUnit._instruction: Add the native unit that is used for this custom coordinate framework.
